link: A page on the site, a phone number (tel: then the digits) or another website. Type #quote to jump to the quote form on the same page.
open_in_new_tab: Not needed for other websites: they open in a new tab by themselves. Leave off for pages on the site.
style_class: Horizon's own style. Leave as is: the **Style** under **Tangent style** overrides it.
width: Keep **Fit**. **Custom** at 100% makes the button fill its column, as in the closing call rows.
width_mobile: Keep **Fit**. **Custom** at 100% makes the button fill its column, as in the closing call rows.
icon: Use **Tangent phone** on every call button. **Phone on call links** shows the phone icon only when the link is a phone number.
ts_style: **Primary, neutral** (black) for the main action, **Secondary** (white with a line) for the second. Keep **Accent** for selection and progress. Overrides **Style** above.
